content.text: Stripe and PayPal's platform fees are crippling for digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, forcing them to abandon their businesses or accept loss-making conversions. In Zimbabwe, currency collapse and financial isolation made these platforms unusable for years. The answer lies in infrastructure [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-3|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-3|sovereign]]ty, where you, the creator, own your digital commerce stack, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how|Payment Gateways]]s' 0.5% fee for crypto on-chain verification is a game-changer. This breakdown will show you how to sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, and why it's a must-have for creators in restricted regions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Selling digital products requires a payment gateway, but the existing options are often restrictive, charging high fees or imposing platform controls. This is where NOWPayments comes in, offering a 0.5% fee for crypto on-chain verification, a significant reduction from Gumroad's 10% platform fee. By using NOWPayments, creators can save money, maintain full ownership of their digital products, and deploy their commerce stacks without relying on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A digital commerce stack consists of a hosting platform, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and a payment gateway. Using NOWPayments, you can integrate cryptocurrency payment processing into your stack, eliminating the need for PayPal or Stripe. Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages provide free hosting, while Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic and order storage. Supabase and Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 deliver files.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack consists of NOWPayments for payment processing, Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Each component is designed to work seamlessly with the others, ensuring a smooth and efficient digital commerce experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by choosing your hosting platform and backend logic, then integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets and deliver files using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Don't forget to configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides instant access to all six blueprints and seven templates, making it easy to build, deploy, and scale your stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.

Creators looking for a payment solution that's independent of traditional platforms can connect the dots between NOWPayments and the sovereign digital commerce stack. By leveraging this technology, they can save money, maintain full ownership, and deploy their commerce stacks without relying on third-party platforms.
